requirements_summary: Product team (customer success + in-app assistant) needs low-p95 latency for short chat turns, predictable cost for heavy embedding and reranking workloads, and VPC for customer data. Primary workload: session-based support agent + doc search. Target SLOs: p95 latency <= 200ms for short responses, 500ms acceptable for longer summaries. Must support SSO/SAML and audit logs. Data residency: US-only for regulated customers.
poc_results: Hosted trial (6 weeks): 120k API requests, 450M tokens consumed (inbound+outbound)
Observed average token mix: 65% chat (short prompts), 25% document embeddings, 10% reranking/long summaries
Measured p50/p95 latency on hosted: 75ms / 320ms (varying by prompt length)
Errors: transient 429s during peak concurrent bursts (spikes to ~70 concurrent requests)
capacity_forecast:
Using hosted trial as baseline, forecast for Dedicated:
- steady-state QPS: 12 req/s
- peak QPS (30 min spikes): 85 req/s
- expected concurrency target: 25 concurrent model contexts
- monthly token estimate: 1.8B tokens (inbound+outbound)
- token mix: ~70% chat-generation, 20% embeddings, 10% reranking
Require autoscale for burst windows and ability to reserve baseline capacity to guarantee throughput. Expect to provision 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs initially with autoscale headroom to 8 for peak testing.
pricing_expectation: Mid-market budget constraint — target committed spend ~$50k-$100k ARR for year 1 with staged ramp. Asking for clear delta between Hosted unit pricing vs Dedicated committed pricing and burst/overage rules.
